title: Vegan Ramen Adventure: LA Tasting at Gokoku and Studio Mushroom-Chashu Recipe

locations.name: Los Angeles, California (probable)
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly references finding the best vegan ramen in LA; on-location visit to a LA ramen shop named Gokoku and subsequent studio work nearby

summary: In this Goodful episode, host Merle and guest Ree explore vegan ramen through two lenses: an on-location tasting at the LA-based ramen shop Gokoku (featuring a Beyond Meat ramen and no-eggs noodles) and a studio kitchen where they recreate a multi-component vegan ramen. Back in the studio, they build a mushroom-based vegan chashu from king oyster mushrooms, craft a miso-dashi broth with a miso tare, and assemble three bowls for comparison. The video blends cooking demonstrations (dehydrating, shaping, and frying mushroom “chashu”; dashi from kombu and shiitake; a mushroom-cashew broth) with palate-testing and playful competition, culminating in a rating that reflects texture, flavor, and overall vegan ramen appeal. The episode also foregrounds the idea of plant-based versions that honor traditional ramen flavors while celebrating cross-cultural influences in Japanese cuisine.
topics: green onions, bok choy, radish toppings

sections.description: Merle and Ree lay out the mission: travel to LA for vegan ramen, return to the studio to craft their own vegan ramen, and have Ree pick a favorite. The setup establishes the friendly competition format and the expectation of exploring authentic flavors through a vegan lens.

sections.title: Gokoku tasting and restaurant context
sections.description: Discussion and tasting context at the Gokoku ramen shop. The segment covers how the restaurant builds vegan ramen (including no-egg noodles) and its fusion approach, along with host dialogue about expectations and nostalgia around ramen flavors.

sections.title: Studio vegan chashu prep and technique
concepts: dehydration with salt to draw moisture
massaging and rolling to resemble pork
sections.description: Back in the studio, Merle and Ree prepare a mushroom-based chashu. They salt and massage the mushrooms to dehydrate them, slice and roll to mimic pork, and prepare a cornstarch dredge for frying to achieve a pork-like texture.

sections.title: Broth foundations and final assembly
concepts: adashi/dashi base with kombu and shiitake
miso tare with miso paste, chili bean paste, sesame oil, soy
toppings and finish (bok choy, radish, corn, green onions, sesame, nori, vegan butter)
sections.description: The broth is built from a miso-dashi foundation, then fortified with a miso tare. The simmering process is used to develop flavor, with a note on soy milk addition to avoid curdling. The bowls are finished with a vibrant array of vegetables, sesame, nori, vegan butter, and the mushroom chashu, culminating in a three-bowl tasting event.
